ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio with approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels across the central ventral surface and 15% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the trailing edges and terminal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white region occupies the central lobes. Low-intensity black banding occurs along the entire trailing edge boundary. Discrete low-intensity circular clusters are scattered across the mid-section and distal areas of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees, showing symmetrical convergence from the medial lobe edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations. The left lobe exhibits a jagged, saw-tooth pattern. The right lobe features a large, deep irregular concave indentation (approx. 15% of lobe width) near the terminal tip, followed by smaller inconsistent valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a non-uniform concave curve from the terminal tips toward the median notch, interrupted by significant geometric irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several dark, roughly circular pixel clusters (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) visible on the white ventral surface, predominantly in the lower-mid quadrant of the right lobe and the upper-mid quadrant of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible extending inwards from the trailing edge of the left lobe, primarily in the medial region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss/indentation on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe; presence of dark focal spots/marks against the high-intensity background across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme asymmetry in the trailing edge topography between the left and right lobes due to large-scale distal indentations on the right lobe.
